==About==
This template is a modified version of the {{Tl|Quote}} template. It is used for quotes that were originally spoken in a foreign language and later translated into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] (English) and was used to present the [[Wookieepedia:Quote of the Day|Quote of the Day]] on the wiki [[Main Page]].

==Usage instructions==
<pre><nowiki>{{Quotetrans|quote|attribution|source}}</nowiki></pre>

===Notes===
*If any text is assigned to the ''source'' field, it will be rendered as a browser [[Wikipedia:Tooltip|tooltip]].

==Example==
===Code===
<code><nowiki>{{Quotetrans2|Bring her to me!|[[Jabba]] in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]|Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi}}</nowiki></code>

===Result===
{{Quotetrans2|Bring her to me!|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]|Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi}}
